name: Haus Wiesenblick
beschreibung: The Gasthof Haus Wiesenblick is located in a quiet setting at the edge of a village in Tirol. The rooms are practically furnished and have a balcony with a view of the mountain meadows. The house's amenities include free Wi-Fi and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The surrounding nature offers opportunities for hiking and cycling tours in summer. In winter, nearby ski areas serve as excursion destinations and can be reached by ski bus. In the inn restaurant, dishes from Tirol are offered daily. The accommodation is suitable both for active holidaymakers and for guests seeking peace and quiet.
